summary: Iteration 7 — secure /admin/secrets vault verified end-to-end. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_secrets.py = 13/13 PASSED covering: (1) GET /api/admin/secrets/status requires admin (401/403 for anon/customer) and returns only boolean flags + source (no mp_access_token/mp_webhook_secret keys in payload); (2) POST /api/admin/secrets is owner-only — staff (role=staff, mfa_enabled=true) receives 403 'Somente o proprietário configura credenciais de pagamento', customer receives 401/403; (3) Format validation: token <20 chars → 400, token containing space → 400, empty body → 400; (4) Owner saving fake TEST-<40 chars> token + fake webhook secret returns 200 {ok:true, connection_test:{ok:false, detail:'provedor respondeu 401 — verifique o token'}} — value is NOT echoed back in response body or in /admin/secrets/status or /admin/settings; (5) After save, status flips to mp_access_token_set=true, mp_webhook_secret_set=true, source='formulario'; (6) DB doc db.app_secrets.findOne({key:'payments'}) stores the value server-side only (confirmed via direct mongosh, never via API); (7) Payment mode regression: with credentials present (fake), PATCH/POST /admin/settings payment_mode='mp_test' is not refused with 'faltam credenciais'. Frontend UI (owner injected via mongosh, token in localStorage.adega_token): Configurações tab visible, secrets section renders with data-testid=secret-mp-token, secret-mp-webhook, secrets-save-btn plus settings-save-btn and settings-payment-mode; initial state shows 'não configurado' badges (both). After typing fake token+webhook and clicking secrets-save-btn: inputs cleared to '', badges flip to green 'configurado' x2, and neither fake value is present anywhere in the DOM (checked via page.content()). Mobile viewport 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390) and Configurações tab reachable. Cleanup executed: db.app_secrets.deleteMany({}) → 0 docs; db.store_settings payment_mode reverted to 'demo'; test users/sessions removed; backend restarted to flush runtime credentials. Owner mgrodrigues920@gmail.com read-only: {role:'owner', mfa_enabled:true} — untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py save_secrets (line ~1225): audit payload uses set difference `list(update.keys() - {'updated_by','updated_at'})` — this works on dict_keys but is slightly non-obvious; `[k for k in update if k not in ('updated_by','updated_at')]` reads clearer.

payments_mp.test_connection returns exception type name in the detail string (`falha de comunicação: TimeoutException`) — safe (no token value) but consider mapping to a user-friendly Portuguese message.

load_secrets() at startup silently swallows errors if the mongo query fails (no try/except). If DB is temporarily unavailable at boot, mp remains unconfigured — probably intended, but a warning log would help operators debug.

AdminPage.jsx line 515: the payment_mode <option value='mercadopago_test'> vs the backend's likely internal enum: worth double-checking the value mapping since prior test data may have used 'mp_test'. Not tested here but flagged for consistency (out of scope for iteration 7).

AdminPage.jsx saveSecrets does not re-fetch settings.mp_configured after a successful save, only secrets/status — the payment_mode guard warning ('Credenciais não configuradas') may remain stale until the page is refreshed. Minor UX inconsistency.
test_credentials: Ephemeral: owner session injected via mongosh (test_adm_session_ui_*), staff/customer sessions similarly injected in pytest module. All deleted at end. Owner mgrodrigues920@gmail.com untouched (verified read-only snapshot).
seed_data_creation: In-test only: app_secrets doc with fake TEST- token (deleted at end), 3 test users (owner/staff/customer with mfa_enabled matching required_admin rules) and their user_sessions. Full cleanup executed post-test — mongosh confirms db.app_secrets.count=0 and store_settings.payment_mode='demo'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Secrets vault UX pattern established: values enter via password inputs → POST /admin/secrets → server persists to app_secrets + calls set_runtime_credentials → connection test uses GET /users/me → response omits any credential value. When mp_test payment_mode is enabled with fake creds the runtime is 'poisoned' — if you don't restart backend after tests that call POST /admin/secrets with fake tokens, subsequent tests may see mp_configured=true even after db cleanup. Autouse fixture in test_admin_secrets.py wipes app_secrets before+after, but does NOT clear runtime memory; a supervisor restart after this iteration was performed. When testing the UI, inject session via mongosh and set localStorage.adega_token = <sessionToken> (see AuthContext line 33). No cookies needed.
rca of the issue: N/A — iteration is a feature verification, no defects observed.
